latest_release.name: Piik v2.6.3
latest_release.body:
### English

This maintenance update fixes Windows H.264 startup and reopening App-hosted sites.

- Request the H.264 profile that Piik actually negotiates. This fixes the AMD encoder startup rejection reported in #538 without loosening the encoded-stream checks or changing the negotiated profile.
- When an App-hosted site is saved as the startup destination, restart its Local or public-invitation mode instead of reopening an expired temporary address. This applies to desktop and Android Apps.
- Clear a stale startup error once the site is ready, and restore only startup modes available in the current App.
- Keep action labels visible in compact header menus on narrow screens.

Existing 2.x App/site compatibility and saved room data are preserved. Update the App for the Windows encoder and startup fixes. Refresh open site pages after updating a hosted Server; App-local pages use the Web UI included in the updated App package.

If a temporary invitation address was saved before this update, start the site again from the App launcher and select “Open this site when Piik App starts” again. Previously saved addresses do not identify which App created them.

### 中文

本次维护更新修复 Windows H.264 启动失败，以及 App 自托管站点的再次打开问题。

- 让 H.264 编码器请求与 Piik 实际协商的编码规格一致，修复 #538 报告的 AMD 编码器启动被拒绝问题；不放宽码流检查，也不改变协商规格。
- 将 App 自己托管的站点设为启动入口后，下次启动会恢复局域网或公网邀请模式，不再打开已经失效的临时网址。桌面和 Android App 均适用。
- 站点已经就绪时清除过期的启动错误，只恢复当前 App 可用的启动模式。
- 保留窄屏顶部菜单中的操作文字，避免按钮只剩图标。

保留现有 2.x App／站点兼容性及已保存的房间数据。Windows 编码器和启动修复需要更新 App。托管 Server 更新后请刷新已打开的页面；App 本地页面使用新版 App 包内的网页。

曾保存过旧临时网址的用户，请从 App 启动页重新开启站点，并重新勾选一次“启动 App 时打开此站点”。旧记录无法判断这个临时网址由哪个 App 创建。

### Security / 安全更新

- Build App and Server with Go 1.27.4, including the upstream HTTP request-body security correction (GO-2026-6859).
- App 和 Server 升级至 Go 1.27.4 构建，包含上游 HTTP 请求体处理安全修复（GO-2026-6859）。

### Capture reliability / 采集稳定性

- Preserve buffered capture output when the native helper exits, so closing the process cannot discard its final frame or replace the original failure with a closed-pipe error.
- 保留原生采集进程退出时尚未读取的数据，避免提前关闭管道丢失尾帧，或将原始失败变成“管道已关闭”。

### Verification / 验证

- Make the route-recovery release check wait for the matching state update. This changes verification only, not runtime routing.
- 路由恢复验收改为等待对应的状态更新；此项仅修正验证时序，不改变运行时路由。

---

[Full changelog / 完整变更](https://github.com/TNTcraftHIM/Piik/compare/v2.6.2...6d138f89452a82a4aeaff3881e400f52c6909851)

detail.readme:
Piik

Share the good stuff.
Private screen sharing for you and up to 20 friends.

Website · Download · AtomGit mirror · Use online · Documentation

English · 简体中文

Piik is a free, open-source screen sharing tool for private live streams with friends: games, movie nights, drawings and photos. Choose what to share and send an invitation. Your friends watch in their browsers. You can also self-host Piik on your own server.
A little room · Show / hide animation

[Features](#features) · [Get started](#get-started) · [Self-hosting](#self-hosting) · [Contributing](#contributing) ## Features - **Watch without installing.** Friends join by invitation in a desktop or mobile browser. - **Share from Piik App or an existing Piik site.** Choose a screen, window, browser tab or camera; available sources and audio depend on the platform. - **Direct connections first.** Media travels between participants where possible (P2P). A self-hosted server can provide automatic media forwarding (SFU) as a fallback. - **Rooms you control.** Invitations, room codes and optional room passwords, for one host and up to 20 viewers. - **Talk and chat together.** Join room voice, send messages and reactions, or enable on-screen chat. - **Hand control to friends.** Share an App window or screen and approve remote control. Allow friends to play together with shared keyboard/mouse or supported gamepads; take control back at any time. [Setup guide](./docs/guide/remote-control.md). - **Flexible viewing.** Light and dark themes, playback controls, picture-in-picture and a connection topology view. - **One program to host a site.** Web UI, room management and optional media forwarding are packaged together.


Interface preview · Sample room with a generated game scene

## Get started **To watch:** open the invitation your friend sends you. Select **Play** if the picture does not start automatically. **To share:** download **Piik App** to get started. To share without installing, you can also create a room in the online version. | Start here | What you need to do | | --- | --- | | [Use Piik online](https://demo.piik.tv) | Share from a desktop browser, or choose Camera on a phone with browser camera support. | | [Download Piik App](https://piik.tv/#download) | Extract the desktop package or install the mobile app, open Piik, choose **Public invite**, then **Open Piik**. |

1. Select **Start sharing**, then choose the picture and audio to share. 2. Select **Copy invite link** and send it to your friends. Keep the sharing tab open. Open **Interact → Voice** to talk together, with or without picture sharing. The Host opens voice; everyone joins to listen and chooses when to turn on their microphone. Piik follows your system language: Chinese or English, with English as the fallback. Use **中 / EN / ✦** in the header to switch language or try the visual mode. The App can create a local room or temporary public invitation, and stays available to supply capture for an approved site. Keep it running while sharing. [**Illustrated getting started →**](./docs/guide/getting-started.md) · [**Troubleshooting →**](./docs/guide/troubleshooting.md) Choose a download beginning with **`piik-app`**. The guide covers installation, source selection and invitations. Browser capture requires HTTPS or `localhost`. The App's temporary public link and the online version use P2P and need a usable UDP connection between participants. For campus networks, failed media connections or virtual LANs, see [network checks and connection options](./docs/guide/network.md). ## Self-hosting Deploy Piik Server to run a site for your group.

Piik Server runs on Windows x64 and Linux x64/ARM64, with the web interface built in. Download the Server package for Linux x64 (`piik--runtime.tar.gz`) or ARM64 (`piik--linux-arm64-runtime.tar.gz`), extract it, and run: ```sh ./piik-server ``` Windows x64 uses `piik--windows-amd64-runtime.zip`; extract it and run `./piik-server.exe` in PowerShell. The same configuration applies. Open `http://localhost:8787` to try it locally. For a public site, configure your domain, HTTPS reverse proxy and STUN address. Room data is stored in SQLite. For containers, use the [Docker Compose setup](./docs/operations/self-hosting.md#docker-compose). [**Deploy your own site →**](./docs/operations/self-hosting.md) · [Configuration](./docs/standards/configuration.md) · [Run from source](./docs/README.md#run-from-source) ## Contributing Bug reports, translations, documentation improvements and pull requests are welcome. See [ways to contribute](./CONTRIBUTING.md#ways-to-help) or [help translate Piik](./docs/guide/translating.md). Use the [repository layout](./docs/standards/engineering.md#repository-layout) to find your way around. ## License Piik-owned code is [MIT licensed](./LICENSE). Dependencies retain their own [licenses and notices](./licenses/README.md). ## Project activity
detail.readme_zh:
Piik

来，看点
好康的。
私密屏幕共享，邀请最多 20 位朋友观看。

官网 · 下载 · AtomGit 镜像 · 在线版 · 文档中心

English · 简体中文

Piik 是一个免费开源的私密屏幕共享工具，适合游戏直播、一起看电影、展示绘画或分享照片。 选择画面，把邀请链接发给朋友，对方用浏览器即可观看。也支持自部署，搭建自己的 Piik 站点。
客厅小剧场 · 展开 / 收起动画

[功能](#功能) · [开始使用](#开始使用) · [自行部署](#自行部署) · [参与贡献](#参与贡献) ## 功能 - **观看无须安装。** 朋友通过邀请链接，用电脑或手机浏览器加入。 - **用 Piik App 或已有 Piik 站点分享。** 支持屏幕、窗口、浏览器标签页和摄像头；可选来源与音频能力取决于平台。 - **优先直接连接。** 画面优先在设备之间传输（P2P），自建站点可启用媒体转发（SFU）自动兜底。 - **房间由你管理。** 支持邀请链接、房间号和可选的房间密码，一位房主、最多 20 位观众。 - **边看边聊。** 加入房间语音，发送文字和表情，也可开启弹幕。 - **让朋友接手操作。** 通过 Piik App 分享窗口或屏幕并授权远控，也可允许多人共用键鼠或使用受支持的手柄一起玩，随时结束控制。[查看设置方法](./docs/guide/remote-control.zh-CN.md)。 - **灵活的观看方式。** 支持深浅主题、播放控制、画中画和连接拓扑查看。 - **一个程序就能建站。** 网页、房间管理和可选的媒体转发打包在同一服务端程序中。


界面预览 · 示例房间与生成的游戏画面

## 开始使用 **观看分享：** 打开朋友发来的邀请链接。画面没有自动播放时，点击**播放**即可。 **分享画面：** 推荐下载 **Piik App**。想免安装，也可以打开在线版直接创建房间。 | 从这里开始 | 需要做什么 | | --- | --- | | [使用在线版](https://demo.piik.tv) | 用电脑浏览器分享画面；手机浏览器支持摄像头访问时，也可选择摄像头分享。 | | [下载 Piik App](https://piik.tv/?lang=zh-CN#download) | 电脑上解压程序包，手机或平板安装 App。打开 Piik，选择**公网邀请**，点击**进入 Piik**。 |

1. 点击**开始分享**，选择要分享的画面和声音。 2. 点击**复制邀请链接**，发给朋友。分享期间保持标签页打开。 打开 **互动 → 语音** 即可一起聊天，开播前后都能使用。 房主开启语音后，大家自行加入收听，想说话时再打开自己的麦克风。 Piik 默认跟随系统语言，中文系统显示简体中文，其他语言显示英文。 顶部的 **中 / EN / ✦** 可切换中英文或体验纯视觉模式。 Piik App 可创建本地房间或临时公网邀请，也能在后台为已授权站点提供采集能力。分享期间需保持 App 运行。 [**图文上手教程 →**](./docs/guide/getting-started.zh-CN.md) · [**问题排查 →**](./docs/guide/troubleshooting.zh-CN.md) 选择以 **`piik-app`** 开头的程序包；教程介绍安装、选择画面和邀请朋友的完整步骤。 浏览器采集需要 HTTPS 或 `localhost`。Piik App 的公网邀请和在线版使用 P2P， 参与者之间需要可用的 UDP 通路。校园网、画面连接失败或虚拟局域网的用法，见[网络排查与连接方案](./docs/guide/network.zh-CN.md)。 ## 自行部署 部署 Piik Server，为朋友搭建自己的站点。

Piik Server 是内置网页界面的独立程序，支持 Windows x64 和 Linux x64／ARM64。 根据服务器架构下载 Linux x64 的 `piik--runtime.tar.gz` 或 ARM64 的 `piik--linux-arm64-runtime.tar.gz`，解压后运行： ```sh ./piik-server ``` Windows x64 可下载 `piik--windows-amd64-runtime.zip`，解压后在 PowerShell 运行 `./piik-server.exe`；配置方式相同。 打开 `http://localhost:8787` 即可在本机试用。对外提供服务时， 再配置域名、HTTPS 反向代理和 STUN 地址。房间数据保存在 SQLite 中。 也可以使用 [Docker Compose 部署](./docs/operations/self-hosting.zh-CN.md#使用-docker-compose)。 [**部署自己的站点 →**](./docs/operations/self-hosting.zh-CN.md) · [配置参考](./docs/standards/configuration.md) · [从源码运行](./docs/README.md#run-from-source) ## 参与贡献 欢迎反馈问题、参与翻译、改进文档或贡献代码。 从[社区参与方式](./CONTRIBUTING.md#ways-to-help)或 [翻译教程](./docs/guide/translating.zh-CN.md)开始，也可以从 [项目目录说明](./docs/standards/engineering.md#repository-layout)了解代码结构。 ## 许可 Piik 自有代码采用 [MIT 许可](./LICENSE)，依赖保留各自的[许可与声明](./licenses/README.md)。 ## 项目动态
